**Meta Description:** Overwhelmed by clutter? Learn how to declutter your home or office with our step-by-step guide and expert tips from 1-800-GOT-JUNK? **Keywords:** decluttering, clutter removal, junk removal, organizational tips, overwhelmed, 1-800-GOT-JUNK?, home decluttering, office decluttering **How to Declutter When You're Overwhelmed** Are you feeling buried under a mountain of clutter? Do you find it impossible to decide where to start when it comes to decluttering your home or office? You're not alone. Decluttering can be a daunting task, but with the right approach and some expert advice from 1-800-GOT-JUNK?, you can get your space organized and back to normal in no time. **Step 1: Prepare for Decluttering** Before you start decluttering, it's essential to prepare yourself for the task at hand. Here are a few tips to get you started: * **Schedule a block of time**: Set aside a specific time each day or week to focus on decluttering. This will help you make progress without feeling overwhelmed. * **Gather supplies**: Collect boxes, bags, and labels to help you sort and organize your clutter. * **Enlist help**: Recruit family members or friends to join you in the decluttering process. This will not only make the task more manageable but also more enjoyable. * **Take breaks**: Decluttering can be physically and emotionally exhausting. Be sure to take breaks and practice self-care throughout the process.

Step 2: Categorize and Purge

Once you're ready to start decluttering, it's time to sort through your belongings and decide what to keep and what to discard. Here are some tips to help you categorize and purge: * **Sort items into categories**: Divide your clutter into categories such as papers, clothes, books, and kitchen items. * **Ask yourself questions**: Ask yourself questions like "When was the last time I used this item?", "Does it have sentimental value?", and "Can I replace it if I need it again?" * **Let go of duplicates**: Get rid of duplicate items that serve the same purpose. * **Consider the 80/20 rule**: 80% of the time, you likely only use 20% of your belongings. Keep this in mind when deciding what to keep and what to discard.

What to Do with Unwanted Items

So, what do you do with all the unwanted items you've collected? Here are a few options: * **Donate**: Consider donating gently used items to local charities or thrift stores. * **Sell**: Sell items that are still in good condition but no longer needed. * **Recycle**: Recycle items that can be repurposed or recycled. * **Dispose**: Unfortunately, some items may be beyond repair or donation. It's essential to dispose of them responsibly.

Step 3: Organize and Maintain

Once you've decluttered and purged your unwanted items, it's time to organize what's left. Here are some tips to help you maintain your newly decluttered space: * **Use storage containers**: Use storage containers to keep items off the floor and out of sight. * **Label everything**: Labeling your storage containers and shelves will help you quickly identify what's inside. * **Create a maintenance routine**: Set aside time each week to maintain your newly decluttered space. * **Stay on top of clutter**: Make it a habit to put things back in their place as soon as you're done using them. **Get a Free Quote from 1-800-GOT-JUNK?** If decluttering feels too overwhelming, consider hiring the professionals at 1-800-GOT-JUNK? to take care of the heavy lifting for you.
